title: CHAPTER 5: CULTURE, ART AND HERITAGE OF GOA

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Konkani written in Devanagari script is the official language of the state of Goa.
The Churches and Convents of Velha Goa are recognized UNESCO World Heritage Sites, featuring iconic monuments like the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral.
The 12th-century Mahadev Temple at Tambdi Surla, built by the Kadamba Dynasty, is the oldest surviving temple in Goa.
Feni, a traditional alcoholic spirit derived from cashew apple juice or coconut sap, holds a Geographical Indication (GI) status.
Goan performing arts reflect a unique blend of indigenous Hindu folk traditions (Fugdi, Dhalo) and Portuguese-influenced music and dance (Mando, Corridinho).

blocks.content: Goa is a multilingual state with a rich linguistic heritage. Konkani is the official language, but Marathi, English, Portuguese, and Hindi are widely spoken.

cells: Official State Language; 8th Schedule language (1992); mother tongue of majority Goans

blocks.content: Goa is unique in India for its harmonious blend of Hindu, Christian, and Muslim communities, a legacy of its complex history.

cells: Largest group; 350+ temples; Shantadurga, Mangeshi are major temples
Legacy of Portuguese rule; beautiful churches including UNESCO World Heritage churches
Small but significant community; mosques in Panaji, Ponda, Bicholim

blocks.content: 5.3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Goa
Churches and Convents of Goa represent a unique fusion of Indo-Portuguese art and architecture.
The Churches and Convents of Old Goa are inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site (1986). This is Goa's only UNESCO World Heritage Site.

items: Dekhnni — Traditional Goan dance performed by female dancers; semi-classical style

Corridinho — Ballroom folk dance of Portuguese origin
Mando — Lyrical romantic song and dance form; sentimental ballad of Goa
Dhalo — Folk dance performed exclusively by women during the month of Paush (winter)

blocks.content: Goan cuisine is one of the most distinctive in India. It blends indigenous Saraswat Brahmin cooking with Portuguese influences, resulting in unique dishes.

items: Basilica of Bom Jesus contains the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, making it a recurring topic in competitive exams.
Cashew Feni was granted Geographical Indication (GI) status in 2009 under agricultural products.
Tambdi Surla Temple is constructed from weather-resistant black basalt in the Kadamba-Yadava architectural style.

blocks.content: Feni has been granted a Geographical Indication (GI) tag and is recognized as Goa's Heritage Drink. Cashew Feni is made from cashew apple juice; Coconut Feni (Mado) is made from coconut toddy.
